scope: one-sided label-free site suppression selected only on authorized development folds

search.formula: logit(current) + weight * min(0, mean(site top-k current logits) - logit(cutoff))

gates.selection: combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance
gates.confirmation: same fixed candidate has combined AP and recall improve, paired AP lower CI positive, every fold AP nonnegative and recall within tolerance

interpretation.hypothesis: site-level temporal evidence is safest as a false-positive suppressor, never a score booster

invariants: Every candidate score is asserted no higher than its frozen current score.
All 36 candidates, gates, and bootstrap seeds are frozen before development scoring.
The rule uses only physical grouping and frozen current scene scores at inference.
Failure writes no artifact and blocks fresh-safety or paper replay.
